title: HiMPO: Hindsight-Informed Memory Policy Optimization for Less-Entangled Credit in Long-Horizon Agents
abstract: arXiv:2606.16285v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Long-horizon agents rely on memory mechanisms to compress interaction history, but optimizing memory writing faces a distinct credit assignment challenge: a memory update may be rewarded or penalized due to downstream tool failures, noisy observations, or reasoning errors rather than its own contribution. We propose HiMPO, a Hindsight-Informed Memory Policy Optimization framework for assigning less-entangled credit to memory-writing actions in long-horizon agents. HiMPO first estimates the local utility of a memory update by comparing the task-relevant information recoverable from the previous and updated memories under the same pre-write state. It then uses hindsight relevance as a bounded retrospective filter that attenuates memory credit when local utility is not supported by the target outcome. translated_title: HiMPO：面向长时程智能体低纠缠信用分配的后见之明引导记忆策略优化
translated_abstract: 长时程智能体依赖记忆机制来压缩交互历史，但优化记忆写入面临一个独特的信用分配挑战：记忆更新可能因下游工具故障、噪声观测或推理错误而非其自身贡献而受到奖励或惩罚。我们提出了HiMPO，一个用于为长时程智能体中记忆写入动作分配低纠缠信用的后见之明引导记忆策略优化框架。HiMPO首先通过在相同的预写入状态下比较可从先前记忆和更新后记忆中恢复的任务相关信息，来估计记忆更新的局部效用。然后，它将后见相关性用作一个有界的回溯过滤器，当局部效用得不到目标结果支持时衰减记忆信用。由此产生的记忆特定优势仅应用于记忆token，而轨迹级奖励则优化智能体的其余部分。
tldr: HiMPO框架将后见相关性作为有界回溯过滤器，为长时程智能体的记忆写入动作分配与下游工具故障等因素解耦的低纠缠信用，并仅对记忆token应用记忆特定优势进行优化。
en_tdlr: HiMPO uses hindsight relevance as a bounded retrospective filter to assign less-entangled credit to memory-writing actions in long-horizon agents, applying memory-specific advantages only to memory tokens.
